message:
The afl directory is just the AFL tool itself, not the built fuzzer. The fuzzer binary would be built by the build.sh. Let me check if there's a built binary somewhere, or if I need to build it. Let me check the OUT directory and see if the target is already built.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>echo $OUT; ls -la /out 2>/dev/null; ls -la /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt/.libs/ 2>/dev/null | head; echo "---"; find / -name "xslt" -type f 2>/dev/null | grep -v repo-vul | head</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
